text:
Anna Kim: quick ask — we need 2 visuals for next Wed's webinar to make the benchmark story concrete for devs/pm leads. one heatmap showing speed vs $/1k tokens across hosted/dedicated/private, and one split tail-latency chart (small vs large batch). target: drive demo signups + dedicated inquiries. can design + data pls?
Mike Lopez: +1. can we keep the heatmap simple: x=seq len, y=model family, color=$/1k tokens? want clear delta between hosted and dedicated.
Julia Park: love that. for CTA: put an inline note like "typical infra cost savings: 3-4x" — but only if the numbers back it. mike, do you have the real ratios?
Mike Lopez: checking w/ eng-runtime now. rough quick numbers from last run: hosted ~ $0.10 per 1k tokens, dedicated (reserved) ~ $0.03 per 1k, private on-prem varies but assume $0.025 w/ our quantization suggestions. i'll confirm.
Sam Chen: for the latency chart, propose two lines per model: median and p99, and annotate where batching kicks in (e.g., small batch = <8 requests, large batch = 64). viewers care about tail latency for interactive vs batch.
Anna Kim: perfect. also we need a one-liner to lead the slide: "Same API. 4x lower token cost, predictable latency for production." keep it claim-forward but defensible.
Julia Park: for positioning, call out: developer-first, production-grade economics. don't use raw jargon like "KV cache" on the slide copy. save that for the appendix.
Mike Lopez: eng-runtime says prelim bench results attached — bench-bot: 
```
bench-bot: summary run 2026-03-18
models: rw-v1-small, rw-v1-medium, rw-v1-large
seq lens: 64, 256, 1024
hosted cost per 1k: [0.048, 0.091, 0.162]
dedicated cost per 1k: [0.015, 0.028, 0.052]
median latency ms (small batch): [18, 32, 78]
p99 latency ms (small batch): [120, 310, 450]
median latency ms (large batch): [22, 40, 95]
p99 latency ms (large batch): [180, 420, 800]
notes: derived with prefix cache enabled; quantized kernels for dedicated.
```
Mike Lopez: those are rough but good for visuals. will attach CSV.
Anna Kim: can the design team make the heatmap colors emphasize cost delta (e.g., warm = expensive, cool = cheap) and add a tiny caption: "hosted vs dedicated shown; real workload may vary". need to avoid overclaiming.
Julia Park: inbound routing note — we need two demo CTAs on the slide: "Try hosted API" (self-serve) and "Contact sales for dedicated" (enterprise). route clicks: small/medium orgs -> marketing nurture, >$10k ARR signals -> sales. Sam, can you add a note to the routing doc?
Sam Chen: will add. suggest tagging leads with `benchmark_interest=dedicated_likely` if they view the full slide deck + request a demo.
Anna Kim: timeline — mockups by EOD Friday, final assets by Tue morning. webinar go-live Wed. Mike, Julia: confirm numbers by Thursday so legal can glance.
Mike Lopez: confirming with eng-runtime, will ping when CSV is live.
Julia Park: i'll draft the 1-line lead and 2 supporting bullets for slide copy, will post in this thread for quick review.
Anna Kim: awesome — thanks team. small ask: include a quick 1-panel appendix slide that lists assumptions (batch sizes, seq lengths, pricing model) so we can defend Qs live.
bench-bot: uploaded: /bench-results/2026-03-18/runner-3776.csv (shared link)
Mike Lopez: got it. attaching csv to deck PR now.
Anna Kim: cool. i'll loop in design and ops. @Sam Chen — add routing rule and notification to Sales slack when CTR > 2% for contact-sales CTA. :thumbsup:
Sam Chen: done. added rule and automated alert.
Julia Park: will post final copy here for quick sign-off before slides go to design.
Anna Kim: thanks all — short and sharp.
